Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.hsa_line7_months; model value dropped from the fixture. Inherits line 8 (line 11 is $0.00): Form 8889 (2025), line 12, "Subtract line 11 from line 8. If zero or less, enter -0-". The case (fixtures/2025/classm.json, classm.f8889.2; married filing jointly, household.married yes) has the taxpayer age 55 or older, an eligible individual in all 12 months, 9 of them with family coverage, December family, the last-month rule not used, both spouses with a Form 8889. i8889 p. 7, Additional Contribution Amount Worksheet: "1. $1,000 × number of months eligible"; the owner's reading amb.2025.hsa_line7_months counts every month treated as eligible, 12, so line 7 is $1,000.00 ("If items (1) and (2) apply to all months during 2025, enter $1,000 on line 7" is the all-family case). The model's work, "Additional Contribution Amount Worksheet: 1,000 x 9 family-coverage eligible months / 12", counts only the family months, the reading the owner did not choose. Line 6 ($4,281.25) agrees. Line 13 is $0.00 on both readings (line 2 is $0.00).

Ruling: representation; project retained; model values dropped from the fixture. The taxpayer was eligible in 2 months (both family), had family coverage on December 1 and uses the last-month rule, so line 3 is $8,550 (i8889 p. 4, Line 3, rule 2, "If the last-month rule ... applies, you are considered an eligible individual for the entire year. You are treated as having the same HDHP coverage for the entire year"; rule 3, "If you were, or were considered, an eligible individual for the entire year and you did not change your type of coverage, enter ... $8,550 for a family HDHP"); both sides enter $8,550 on line 3 and agree on lines 5 to 13. The two helpers divide the same result differently: the project's line3_all_year is the filer actually eligible in all twelve months (f8889.all_year, months = 12), so the last-month rule's filer goes through line3_part_year to line3_last_month ($8,550) and line3_all_year is the unused chart branch ($8,550 x 2 / 12 = $1,425); the model filed the rule 3 amount under "all year" (reading "were considered") and the chart under "part year". The values swap; neither is wrong. No change to the data.

Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The taxpayer was eligible in all twelve months (2 of family coverage, family on December 1) and answered No to the last-month rule, so under amb.2025.hsa_last_month_all_year (chosen: the filer who uses the rule is treated as having the December 1 coverage all year; one who does not keeps the actual months) Step 1 and Step 4 use the actual months (i8889 p. 7, Line 6, Step 1, "the total of the worksheet amounts only for the months you were treated as having family coverage"): f8889.step1_total takes the actual-months alternative, on which the model agrees. This helper is the last-month alternative; the project figures it from the December 1 coverage whatever the answer ($8,550 x 12 = $102,600, the married filer's chart amount for twelve months), the model entered $0 as "not used". The spouse rule of line 6 does not apply either (only the taxpayer has a Form 8889), and lines 3 to 13 agree. No change to the data.
